0602-contributors.caption: The default visualizations of contributors (left) and code frequency (right) made available on GitHub.com.
0602-contributors.altText: A webpage displaying bar graphs for select project contributors’ time spent on Github between January 2023 and July 2025. The first bar graph at the top of the page collects everyone’s data, with a noticeable spike in time spent on Github between March and June of 2024. Below this main graph are bar charts for, going clockwise from top left, Jay, Tanvi, Lauren, and Nick. Jay’s time spent is consistently most visible, with his number of contributions being around 20 in the year 2023 and surpassing 50 and 75 in April and May of 2024.

0603-frequency.caption: [ SEE ABOVE ]
0603-frequency.altText: A slim bar graph on Github comparing the additions to the deletions of code over the course of the project’s history. The bars for additions are represented in green and stretch to the positive area of the chart along the vertical y-axis, and deletions are depicted in red in the negative area of the graph. The horizontal x-axis measures time, labeling every sixth month (January or July) of 2023-2025.
